duration.text: The Power engineering at Zhejiang Sci-Tech University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Admission Application Form for International Students of Zhejiang University of Technology(Applicants must first fill in the information through the online application system for international students of Zhejiang University of Technology, http://apply.zstu.edu.cn/) 2. Copy of passport with the applicant's signature 3. For those already residing in China, a copy of the valid visa or residence permit for this entry is also required. 4. Notarized certificate of highest academic degree and academic transcript (original documents in languages other than Chinese or English should be accompanied by translations in Chinese or English) 5. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". Applicants must strictly follow the items required in the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" for the examination. Any missing items, those without the applicant's photo attached, or those with a seam seal on the photo, or those without the signatures and stamps of the doctor and the hospital are invalid. The examination results are valid for 6 months. 6. Copy of HSK certificate or copy of English proficiency certificate (if any) 7. Applicants who are currently studying at other universities in China are required to provide a study certificate, attendance record and academic transcript issued by the international student office of their respective schools. 8. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant legal documents from their legal guardians in China. These documents must be notarized by the Chinese embassy abroad. 9. 5 photos (Requirements: White background color photos, passport-sized photos. The photos should be submitted upon registration.) 10. Other required materials

requirements.text: 1. Have good conduct, be in good health, and be willing to abide by relevant Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations. Generally, the age range is 18 to 30 years old (those under 18 years old must provide relevant legal documents from their legal guardians in China). Foreign citizens who have obtained an equivalent educational qualification to that of a Chinese high school graduate. 2. Language Requirements: 2.1 Chinese-language-taught programs: New HSK Level 4 score of 180 or above 2.2 For English-taught programs, the following conditions must be met at least by one of them: 1) Native language is English 2) The official language is English. 3) High school or university education is in English. 4) TOEFL: 80 or a score of B2 or above in the TOEFL online test 5) IELTS: 5.5 6) Other certificates of English proficiency that meet the requirements 2.3 Requirements for Chinese Proficiency upon Graduation: 1) Chinese language instruction: HSK Level 5 or above 2) English instruction: HSK 4 level or above 3. According to Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, if both or one of the parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled in a foreign country, and the individual acquires foreign nationality at the time of birth, they do not have Chinese nationality. Since 2021, those who apply to enter our university for undergraduate studies as international students must, in addition to meeting other school's application requirements, also hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years (inclusive) or more, and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for 2 years or more within the last 4 years (as of the April 30th of the year of admission). (Nine months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.)
